name: The Loom
start_toast: Three Keys, whole or broken. The Beacon has begun to flicker on its own. Go home.
summary: Three Keys are out of the ground. The Beacon is answering something, and it is answering from the plaza.

catastrophe.summary: Go home. The Beacon is lighting itself.

located.summary: The Beacon's log shows one depth it has never reached: the Loom Approach. The Choir and the rival factions are already on their way down. Act 3 begins.
located.next_toast: The door shuts behind you. There is no way back up but the ending.

objectives.text: Delve the Loom Approach and find the Loom's door

loom.summary: The Loom's hall. The rival factions got here first; the Choir's Voice keeps the last door; the Loom is at the far end.

objectives.text: Get past whoever got here first

set.summary: Your hand on the Loom. Whatever you set, that is the world now.
